platforms.label: Bluesky

auth.method: App Password -> com.atproto.server.createSession on the account service (default bsky.social; optional owner-configured HTTPS PDS origin)

platforms.user_approval_requirements: No developer app review documented for record creation; owner creates an App Password and approves each ReachWeaver post
platforms.metrics_access: Public post counters only (likes, reposts, replies, bookmarks) via read-only metrics-fetch --online on the public AppView app.bsky.feed.getPosts, no credential sent; views, impressions and clicks are not exposed and stay unknown; otherwise manual native observation and CSV import
platforms.edit_delete: Records can be deleted via AT Protocol repo methods; ReachWeaver implements neither edit nor delete

rate_limits.summary: Bluesky-operated PDS hosts (default bsky.social): per account 5,000 repo-write points per hour and 35,000 per day (CREATE 3, UPDATE 2, DELETE 1 point, so at most 1,666 creates per hour and 11,666 per day); com.atproto.server.createSession 30 per 5 minutes and 300 per day per account; all API requests 3,000 per 5 minutes per IP. The docs say limits are likely to evolve and other PDS providers are likely to differ

facts.action: repo record writes (CREATE 3, UPDATE 2, DELETE 1 point)
repo record writes (CREATE 3, UPDATE 2, DELETE 1 point)

not_published: Limits of PDS hosts not operated by Bluesky (owner-configured service): the docs only say other providers are likely to have different limits

compliance_constraints: Use App Password, never main password
Exact handle identity check before send
Text limit 300 graphemes and 3000 UTF-8 bytes (app.bsky.feed.post lexicon); ReachWeaver grapheme count is a conservative approximation
Facets use UTF-8 byte offsets; links and hashtags only, mentions stay plain text (no DID resolution)
Custom PDS service must be a public HTTPS origin; endpoints in the session didDoc are never followed
Deterministic TID rkey per local post so a re-send collides instead of duplicating (createRecord rkey)
platforms.verification_basis: official docs fetched 2026-10-08: docs.bsky.app now 308-redirects to bsky.network (client-rendered), so the tutorial and rich-text guide were read from the official bluesky-social/bsky-docs source; lexicons read from bluesky-social/atproto; TID, record-key and Lexicon specs from atproto.com. Rate limits read 2026-10-09 from the official Rate Limits page (docs.bsky.app/docs/advanced-guides/rate-limits 308-redirects to bsky.network, which redirects to /docs/rate-limits). Adapter mock-tested only
